messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — control-plane service errors (5xx) spike across multiple regions. Rule: controlplane-deps-5xx-threshold. Current 5xx rate: ~14% (5m window). Alerting on-call: Lee (oncall).

Lee (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing gateway 502/504 and timeouts from auth and org-lookup deps. Spike started ~3m ago.

Nora C: Customer-impact: CS dashboard shows increased active error reports for API v2 (chat/generate). Affected customers: 4 with high error volume, several others degraded.

Samira A: Logs show auth service returning 502s, and org-lookup latency > 3s causing request fanout to time out. Possible config rollout earlier today? Paging infra now.

Miguel T: Running quick stack traces and tailing ingress:
```
kubectl -n controlplane logs -l app=gateway --since=2m | grep "5.." | head
gateway-0: upstream error: 502 Bad Gateway from auth.svc:8080
gateway-1: timeout waiting for org-lookup.svc, req_id=abc123
```

Dave R: I can probe auth: `curl -v https://auth.prod.internal/health` returns 200 but requests to `/verify` sometimes 502. Hypothesis: a recent config change increased parallel fanout to org-lookup for each request and pushed auth over connection pool.

Samira A: Confirmed a config rollout at 01:12 UTC — `service-deps: enable_deep_lookup: true` rolled to controlplane. Rolling it back now would reduce fanout. Recommend rollback and open circuit on org-lookup.

Lee (oncall): Can we toggle the rollout flag to false? Who has permission? @Miguel T can you patch the config? If not, fallback to disable via feature-flag service.

Miguel T: On it. Patching config to set `enable_deep_lookup=false` for controlplane via console: `PATCH /config/active -d '{"enable_deep_lookup":false}'`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Miguel T — config rollback candidate id `cfg-2026-0403-17`. Estimated 20s to propagate.

Samira A: Meanwhile, lowering gateway concurrency to limit connections to org-lookup and enabling circuit-breaker on auth path:
```
# temp override on gateway
gateway.overrides.requests_per_host=8
gateway.overrides.cb_open_threshold=50
```

Dave R: I'll add a temporary cache for org-lookup for 60s TTL to reduce pressure. Pushing patch now.

Nora C: CS: telling the four impacted enterprise customers we have identified a dependency-related spike, rolling mitigations now, ETA 5–10m for visible recovery.

Lee (oncall): Good. Keep flight control simple: rollback flag, throttle gateway, cb open lower, add short cache. After deploy, watch error rate and latency.

(30s later)

deploy-bot: Rollback propagated to 3/3 regions. Config revision `cfg-2026-0403-17` applied.

Miguel T: Confirming config reverted. org-lookup traffic down ~70% in samples. Starting to see auth 502s drop.

Samira A: Graphs: 5xx dropping from 14% -> 6% in region-us-west, p95 latency for controlplane requests down from 2.9s -> 1.1s.

Nora C: CS update sent: customers see improvements, we're continuing to monitor.

Dave R: Added short-circuit cache to org-lookup responses, TTL=60s. Patch applied.

Lee (oncall): Great. Are there any remaining errors attributable to billing/config service? I still see a few timeouts upstream.

Miguel T: There's a lingering rate limiter on billing.svc that started rejecting higher QPS. I can bump the soft limit temporarily. Running command: `rbacctl update-rate billing.svc --soft-limit 1200`

Samira A: Also enabling graceful fallback: if org-lookup times out, use stale cached org metadata for 120s rather than failing the entire flow. Small risk of stale data but reduces errors.

Lee (oncall): Apply fallback. Coordinate with QA to ensure no user data corruption.

(2m later)

Samira A: Fallback in place. 5xx now down to ~1.8% cluster-wide. Latency normalized.

Miguel T: Running postmortem checklist: capture traces, preserve logs for 72h, tag spans where `enable_deep_lookup=true` to compare. I'll create an incident ticket.

Lee (oncall): Handoff to Samira for L2 mitigation and postmortem write-up. I'm going offline in 20m. Samira, you have pager.

Samira A: Taking pager. I'll lead the postmortem and own action items: revert risky rollout gating, add preflight load test for deep lookup, add autoscale rule for auth and org-lookup when fanout increases.

Nora C: CS: scheduling follow-up customer updates and drafting post-incident notice for impacted customers.

Dave R: Action items noted: add better connection pooling, improve circuit-breaker defaults, make short-circuit cache configurable by traffic class.

incident-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-043: controlplane-deps-fanout-5xx. Severity: SEV2. Exec notified.

Samira A: Will run blameless postmortem. For now, marking incident as mitigated but monitoring for recurrence.

Lee (oncall): Thanks team. Leave thread open for any regressions.

(Last message)

Samira A: Closing update: 30m since mitigation, error rate stable <2%, customer impact reduced to transient errors only. Postmortem ETA 24h.
